status: a player's habit passed on by the maintainer, 21 Oct 2026; matching unverified
line: A player's habit, passed on by the maintainer on 21 Oct 2026 (traverse timing is otherwise an open question: 'nobody knows'): almost always traverse to Usurper to use the additional action point, ideally banishing 1 more card at little or no cost; sometimes flip back immediately, sometimes stay on Forsaken for a while; with about 4 cards in banish, sometimes not flip back. Logged: TRANSFORM to viserai_usurper, then any card played (M) later that turn, as the proxy for using the extra action point. Action points and the extra banish aren't logged; M also covers weapon attacks, equipment and Gate uses.
expectation: Written 21 Oct 2026, before measuring this chain (seen beforehand: only the data dictionary's total of 2,114 TRANSFORM events on 20 Oct, both directions, about 2.5 per side). Revised the same day, before measuring, because the tool counts games, not individual traverses. 1. How often: in at least 90% of games where Viserai traverses to Usurper, there's at least one traverse after which another card is played later that same turn. 2. When: reported, not judged. 3. Result: those games against the few where it never happens, with life totals held level, 0 to +10 points; the second group will be small, so the interval will be wide.
